scores.reasons: Lane: objective. Its engine and contract reading is accurate. Modal #prevent forces `animated` true and removes `modal-static` on a padded timer (src/browser/Modal.ts:232-257, src/browser/helpers.ts:935-949). Tip #finish skips `hidden` while a trigger is active and keeps a hovered panel connected (src/browser/Tip.ts:318-324), and the panel getter clears only in #disposePanel (:284-292). It correctly reattributes the comment at tests/setupBrowser.ts:3663 to buildComponent. Its tip predicate is scoped to direct children of body (Tip.ts:203), which leaves out the static `.tooltip` specimens at app/browser/sections/tooltips.html:57. All waitForCondition, waitForEvent, and waitForAnimations citations hold: core index.js:241, :251; index.d.ts:804; browser index.js:1329-1371. Four defects cost it the win. (1) It treats the J-B2 pair as reading 10763 and gates U3 to U7 on row equality with that pair. Both runs read dark-390 tooltip `excluded` 10766 (runs/jb2b-1/journey/dark-390.txt:377, runs/jb2b-2/journey/dark-390.txt:377), and rows must agree with every baseline (compare.ts:526-528). If the U6 fix works, its own criterion fails. (2) It keeps COMPONENT_WAIT at 5000 ms and forbids changing it. That is the unmeasured figure the brief rules out. It sizes the floor from 774.5 ms, which was a scroll settle from j0c2 diagnostic runs (tmp/codex/j0c4-history.md:26), and from >1000.5 ms, which is only a lower bound. (3) It uses one per-row cost for all component tables, even though per-row cost differs about tenfold between popover motion=true and motion=false. (4) Its U5 caller rewiring at :5672 and :5711 is incoherent, and its U3 premise test reads a class that is not yet set when the event fires. Its header readings come only from jb2b, while it claims six runs.

Lane: objective. Its measurements are the strongest. It found that 10766 is the majority reading for the 390 tooltip rows: 15 of 18 rows across nine runs, while every 1280 row reads 10763 (verified in each runs/*/journey/dark-390.txt at :370/:377 and :356/:363). It found that the J-B2 pair carries a split outcome, so it re-baselines before any compare gate. It traced 774.5 ms to a scroll settle in j0c2 (tmp/codex/j0c4-history.md:26). It lists every unbudgeted waitForAnimations call site exactly (tests/setupBrowser.ts:1594 … :5353; integration.test.ts:837, :1001). It also catches the literal 5_000 at tests/setupBrowser.ts:3422 and the 1,100 ms control at tests/setupBrowser.test.ts:501-519. It re-derives COMPONENT_WAIT from a probe instead of keeping it, and it gives each table a measured timeout. Its header ranges hold, for example face 32.7 s in completion-b4-journey. Its reading-6 analysis matches the engine (Modal.ts:60, :71, :244-251), and the filter it cites does ignore `style` (tests/setupBrowser.ts:3519-3527). One defect blocks U1 as written: `collectStrayPanels` matches every connected `.tooltip`/`.popover` outside the owned set. That includes the static specimens in main (app/browser/sections/tooltips.html:57), so the wait can never hold. Its explanation of why motion=true passes (index.js:1308-1310) is not proven. The extra probes widen U4 and U5, but both stay bounded.

grafts: From signals into sizing U1: scope the stray-panel predicate to the direct children of body (`:scope > .tooltip, :scope > .popover` under document.body, plus the engine backdrops). Engine panels append to body (src/browser/Tip.ts:203), and no data-bs-container exists in app/browser. The static `.tooltip` specimens at app/browser/sections/tooltips.html:57 must stay outside the predicate. On timeout, keep signals' report of each stray panel's id and state.

From signals into sizing U1 and U2: why the predicate is connection and not the event or phase. `phase` reads 'hidden' with the panel still connected when an active trigger holds it (Tip.ts:127-135, :318-320), and `hidden` fires while hover keeps the panel (Tip.ts:322-324). State this in the unit so the executor does not wait on `hidden.bs.tooltip`.

From signals into sizing U2: also wait for the inline `overflow-y` restore, using the exact settle predicate the engine's own tests use (tests/src/browser/Modal.test.ts:409-415, :464-470). Extract it as one shared predicate, so the act and the engine test cannot drift.

From signals into sizing U3: attach a rejection handler, or rely on Promise.all's single rejection, so that a throwing `pressKeys` leaves no unhandled `waitForEvent` rejection. Write the scrollend risk as signals does: an undelivered scrollend produces a named timeout and never passes silently.

From signals into the risks: name that `waitForPaint` (tests/setupBrowser.ts:1592-1595) is shared by the header rows and the preservation reader. Sizing's U6 budgets it, so the change reaches every header row and needs the header compare.

From signals answer 2 into sizing: the ruling that an engine bounce-completion event is refused, citing the Bootstrap wire-event parity (src/browser/constants.ts:93-99) and the Minimal public API law.
contradictions: signals answer 3 and reading 7 ('The value to hold: 10763, as read by the J-B2 pair'; 'the J-B2 pair agree on it (10763)'): refuted. jb2b-1 and jb2b-2 both read dark-390 tooltip excluded 10766 (/home/user/veneer/tmp/units/journey-cost/runs/jb2b-1/journey/dark-390.txt:377, runs/jb2b-2/journey/dark-390.txt:377); only light reads 10763 (:370).

signals U6 criterion ('The preservation rows equal the J-B2 pair; the light-390 tooltip row reads excluded 10763') and the J-B2 compare criteria in U3, U4, U5, and U7: these contradict each other. A settled reader produces dark 10763, while both baselines hold dark 10766, and rows must agree with every baseline (compare.ts:526-528, USAGE at :27). Right: re-baseline on two post-U6 runs before gating, as sizing U1 does.

signals reading 4 and answer 5 ('Measured: 774.5 ms … The floor is about 1.25 s, so 5000 ms satisfies it'): 774.5 ms was a scroll settle from the j0c2 diagnostic runs (305.69 and 319.32 s walls), not an animation settle (/home/user/veneer/tmp/codex/j0c4-history.md:26). The after-3b reading 'waited 1000.5ms … transform' (runs/completion-b3-journey-after-3b/report.json:1) is a lower bound, so no floor follows from it, and keeping COMPONENT_WAIT at 5000 (tests/setupBrowser.ts:3200) leaves an unmeasured figure in place.

signals U3 premise case ('A hidePrevented.bs.modal listener reads modal-static as present in the same task'): a synchronous listener reads it absent. emitEvent dispatches `hidePrevented` at src/browser/Modal.ts:233, before `classList.add(modal-static)` at :244. The criterion holds only if the listener defers to a microtask.

signals U5 ('Update the callers at :5672, :5683, and :5711 to pass the key they pressed'): the call at tests/setupBrowser.ts:5672 follows a Tab traversal (:5670) and no scroll key. The call at :5711 follows scrollComponentTo, which already pressed (:5705-5709), or pressKeys(event) (:5710). A key-pressing helper at those sites presses twice. Right: route the presses at :5680 and :5710 through the helper and delete the waits at :5672 and :5711, as sizing U3 does.

signals reading 2 sizing (face 25.0 to 28.6 s, pair 27.3 to 28.4 s) is described as 'the six named one-holder runs' but covers jb2b only. completion-b4-journey reads face 32.7 s and pair 32.5 s (runs/completion-b4-journey/report.json:1).

sizing U1 (`collectStrayPanels` returns connected `.tooltip`/`.popover` elements not in `owned`): the predicate never empties.
